about.title: About
about.desc: AAIGC is a collection of free online tools created by independent developer CHEN. All tools run entirely in your browser — no data is sent to any server, and nothing is stored or tracked.
about.desc2: The goal is simple: provide useful, fast, and privacy-respecting tools that anyone can use without signing up or sharing personal information.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.desc: AAIGC is a static website. We do not collect, store, or process any personal data. All tools run entirely in your browser — nothing is sent to our servers. We use a functional cookie to remember your language preference. No tracking or analytics are used.
